metaTitle: Custom Set in Sleeve Shirts | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom set in sleeve shirts for your team. Classic fit with professional decoration options. Bulk pricing available.
introHtml: Set in sleeve shirts offer a classic, tailored fit that sits neatly at the shoulder, making them ideal for uniform programs and corporate apparel. Unlike raglan or drop shoulder styles, the set in sleeve construction provides a clean, professional silhouette that works well with left chest embroidery or full back prints. These shirts are a go-to choice for safety managers and HR directors outfitting teams with a polished, consistent look.
heroAltText: Custom set in sleeve shirts with embroidered logo on left chest, classic fit for corporate uniforms
